author: "The Teacher" (Qoheleth), traditionally Solomon
date: Traditionally c. 900s BC; many scholars date it c. 400–200 BC
overview: The Teacher looks at work, pleasure, wealth and wisdom and concludes that everything "under the sun" is meaningless, like a passing breath. Yet he also urges enjoying simple gifts from God. His conclusion: fear God and keep his commandments.
storyPlace: A wisdom book that faces life's frustrations head-on.
